summary: All 4 entries used the synthesis-only path; together they spanned 5.5 minutes. V606 SOTA ingestion and method map dominated at 5.25 minutes. The idle GPUs were expected for this workload; compute-task GPU efficiency and DualGPURunner engagement had no data available this milestone.
bottlenecks_identified: V606 SOTA ingestion and method map consumed 5.25 of the 5.5 milestone minutes, concentrating nearly all observed wall time in one synthesis-only workflow.
Compute-bound experiment durations and causes: no data available this milestone.
improvements_suggested: Add an automated, cached SOTA-ingestion and method-map generation path so unchanged source material is not reprocessed.
Record stage-level timings within the SOTA-ingestion and method-map workflow to isolate retrieval, parsing, mapping, and artifact-writing costs.
Keep GPU and DualGPURunner checks gated on compute-bound experiment markers; synthesis-only work should remain on the CPU path.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Cache and incrementally update SOTA-ingestion inputs and method-map outputs.
Instrument the longest synthesis workflow with stage-level timing receipts.
Preserve workload-aware GPU checks that do not treat synthesis-only GPU idleness as a fault.
meta_reflection: The milestone was short and entirely synthesis-only, so its operational evidence supports improving the dominant ingestion-and-mapping workflow rather than changing GPU scheduling. A positive savings estimate would not be evidence-backed without a measured follow-up, so the estimate remains 0.
